title: France's Ankama Presents Fantasy TV Anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar
content:
A website opened on Wednesday for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama which will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT). The website also presented the anime's key visual, main cast, and staff members.

The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar. The two boys are from different stations in life, but their destinies intertwine when they try to end a tyrant's plot to conquer the world.

The anime will star:

Rikuya Yasuda as Welsh, a 16-year-old boy who lives in Broccoli village, and is good at cooking

Yūki Kaji as Shedar, the 16-year-old prince of Bonta, the greatest country of the realm

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! (movie trilogy) .

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version.

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.
author: ANN

title: 'Demons' Crest' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the original net anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest light novel announced additional cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.

Cast Teruki Sugamo: Yuusuke Kobayashi ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Aria Misono: Maaya Uchida ( Kaya-chan wa Kowakunai ) Kai Kisanuki: Rie Murakawa ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) Sumika Watamaki: Sora Amamiya ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! )

Kenichirou Komaya ( Hoshifuru Oukoku no Nina ) is directing the anime at Production I.G , with Eiji Umehara ( Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song ) handling the series composition. Yukiko Horiguchi ( 22/7 ) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) and Naoyuki Chikatani ( Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Beast Tamer, Saikyoushu no Nekomimi Shoujo to Deau ) are composing the music.

Kawahara ( Sword Art Online ) began publishing the light novel with illustrations by Yukiko Horiguchi ( Kokoro Connect ) under Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko imprint in November 2022. The fourth volume was released on December 10 last year.

A webtoon adaptation drawn by TOmoe began serialization on Akatsuki's HykeComic platform in November 2022. Kadokawa published the first volume in June 2024, with the second and third volume scheduled for an October 23 release.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in January 2024 and shipped the third volume in December 2025.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Key Visual Revealed, Two Consecutive Cours Starting on January 10, 2027
content:
Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 revealed the first key visual, confirming two consecutive cours and a January 10, 2027 premiere date. The anime is set to continue with the Galaxia Heroes: Chaos action, which was previously teased in a trailer . Studio C2C is again in charge of the animation. The anime was announced alongside the franchise’s first game adaptation immediately after the second season’s finale. You can see the new key visual below.

The first season of Shangri-La Frontier ran for 2 consecutive cours from October to March 2023, with the sequel going from October to March 2024. Returning to direct the sequel was Toshiyuki Kubooka, along with Kurashima Ayumi as the character designer and chief animation director, Kazuyuki Fudeyasu was charge of the series composition, and the trio of Hirokawa Keiichi, Takada Ryuichi amd Takahashi Kuniyuki was in charge of the music. You can watch the trailer for Season 3 below.

The second season previously introduced new cast and characters through some other big arcs, including the Nephilim Hollow Arc (Rie Takahashi as Rust and Kaito Ishikawa as Mordo), Abyss City Arc (Aki Kanada as Stude and Toru Sakurai as Araba), and GGC Arc (Yumi Uchiyama as Megumi Natsume and Minami Takahashi as Silvia Goldberg). The main voice cast for the anime consists of:

• Yuma Uchida as Sunraku/Rakuro Hizutome

• Azumi Waki as Psyger-0/Rei Saiga

• Yoko Hikasa as Arthur Pencilgon/Towa Amane

• Makoto Koichi as Oicazzo/Kei Uomi

• Rina Hidaka as Emul

• Akio Otsuka as Vysache

The original Shangri-La Frontier manga by Ryosuke Fuji (art) and Katarina (story) adapts the web novel by the latter, which has been serialized on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website since May 2017. The manga adaptation is published in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine , and it was also licensed in English by Kodansha USA.

The story follows Rakuro Hizutome, a player going by the name of Sunraku, who loves playing ‘shitty games’ and beating them despite all their bugs and flaws. He then finds a ‘god-tier’ game, Shangri-La Frontier , which he then learns to enjoy, meeting some old gamer friends and looking forward to discovering the most interesting features in the huge world and beating the strongest opponents.

title: Entergram Announces Vtuber Azusa Honami's Azure Memoria Game
content:
Entergram opened a teaser website on Tuesday to announce the "consumer game" Azure Memoria starring VTuber Azusa Honami, who also supervises the game. ("Consumer game" is a Japanese term for a game for consoles or portable game systems, as opposed to a game for arcades, personal computers, or phones.)

Entergram presented the game's teaser visual drawn by Azusa's character designer Riichu :

Azusa is a talent of VTuber agency Specialite, which brings together gaming enthusiasts and focuses primarily on game live streaming.

title: Hi Score Girl's Rensuke Oshikiri, Etrange Overlord's Roman Kitayama Present Noroi Ayashi Horror RPG
content:
Hong Kong-based publisher Game Source Entertainment announced on Wednesday Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity, a new horror role-playing game from developer Clover Lab., inc. The game will launch for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, and PC via Steam in the second quarter of 2027. The game is a collaboration by manga artist Rensuke Oshikiri ( Hi Score Girl , Sayuri , Geniearth ) and Sōhei Niikawa (real name of Etrange Overlord novel series author Roman Kitayama).

Game Source Entertainment describes the game:

The Seven Mysteries and the Cursed Doll Aya In order to uncover the truth behind the mysterious death of her close friend, the protagonist ‘Seira’, together with the members of the school newspaper society, ‘Tae’ and ‘Hime’, ventures into ‘U School’ late at night, a place shrouded in silence and darkness. Set against the backdrop of U School, in addition to the ‘Seven Mysteries’ passed down through the ages, a unique and eerie urban legend is earnestly circulated amongst the students: ‘If you perform a certain ritual, the [Cursed Doll, Aya] will appear and curse the object of your hatred to death’. To verify this urban legend, Seira and her friends performed the forbidden ritual. However, this was not the gateway to the truth, but merely the beginning of a cycle of inescapable nightmares and despair…

The game will be available in Traditional Chinense, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and English subtitles. (Game Source Entertainment also describes the single-player game's genre as "time loop horror RTA stealth action-adventure."

Oshikiri launched the Hi Score Girl manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in 2010, and ended it in September 2018. Square Enix Manga & Books published the manga in English. The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in Japan in July 2018. Netflix began streaming the show outside of Japan in December 2018.

Oshikiri launched the sci-fi adventure manga Geniearth in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in September 2021. The series ended in July 2022. Titan Manga licensed the manga and released the first volume in English on April 14.

Gemdrops ' Etrange Overlord , a game based on Kitayama's novel series of the same name, launched for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam on March 26 in the West, and for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 in Japan on the same date.

Kitayama debuted the Etrange Overlord: Hansei Shinai Akuyaku Reijо̄, Jigoku ni Ochite Kareinaru Happy Life Musо̄ web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō and Kakuyomu in February 2023.

title: Crunchyroll Acquires 7.03% of Japanese Media Company Link-U
content:
Japanese media company Link-U Group announced a new business partnership with Crunchyroll on Monday. The Link-U Group issued an third-party allotment of its shares at 856 yen (about US$5.50) per share, and Crunchyroll will acquire 917 million yen (about US$5.91 million) of those shares of Link-U. After this transaction, Crunchyroll will become the fifth-largest shareholder of Link-U with a 7.03% stake.

Link-U plans to use the investment as part of the "medium-term management plan 2030" strategy that it also announced on Monday. The plan will include expanding the distribution of manga to audiences outside of Japan through developing manga distribution platforms, and localization management.

The Crunchyroll Manga app launched on iOS and Android devices in the United States and Canada in October 2025. The ad-free app is separate from the main Crunchyroll streaming service. Crunchyroll describes the service as being "powered by Link-U Group." Partner publishers for the service include AlphaPolis , Compass, Square Enix , Viz Media , Yen Press , Shueisha , J-Novel Club , and ThirdlineNEXT.

Link-U operates such services as digital manga site Comikey , digital manga store Compass, webtoon company Studio Moon6, and VTuber and streaming production company Romanz. In addition to Crunchyroll Manga, Link-U has worked on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus , Square Enix 's Manga UP! , and similar manga services from other companies.

title: Asaka Performs 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime's Opening Song
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, announced on Sunday that artist Asaka is performing the anime's opening theme song "GO! GO! RAILWAY!!"

The original anime's story centers on four train-loving college students who are members of the Tetsudō Ryokō Dōkō-kai ("Tetsuryo" in short, or literally Railway Travel Club). They journey throughout the world where hundreds of Tetsudō Musume work.

The anime will star:

• May Tachibana as Misaki Sata

• Mao Shōji as Kodama Orihara

• Haruna Fukushima as Ushio Yagami

• Hika Tsukishiro as Usa Harutachi

• Fūka Izumi as Yayoi Nakano

• Yukari Anzai as Arisa Nishiura

• Yuki Nakashima as Chihaya Asakura

• Asami Seto as Sakie Ashio

• Hana Hishikawa as Shiina Igusa

• Ayaka Ōhashi as Juri Okuwa

• Hikaru Tohno as Sia Kasukabe

• Yūki Tenma as Misya Kamii

• Yurika Kubo as Ibuki Kawagoe

• Misaki Kuno as Miyabi Kinugawa

• Mana Kumasaki as Akana Kurihashi

• Minami Takahashi as Misaki Kо̄jiro

• Haruki Iwata as Minano Sakurazawa

• Nene Hieda as Konomi Shibaguchi

• Iori Saeki as Azami Takashima

• Misa Segawa as Izumi Tachikawa

• Suzuka Hara as Tsukushi Togawa

• Kana Ichinose as Karen Matsukaze

• Shiori Mikami as Kinu Watarase

TOMYTEC is credited for the original work in collaboration with I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level novel writer Kisetsu Morita . Misuzu Hoshino ( Laid-Back Camp episode director, Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious director) is directing the anime at East Fish Studio . Aya Satsuki ( Solo Camping for Two , "Ippon" Again! , Too Cute Crisis ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Hisanori Hashimoto ( Laid-Back Camp season 3) is designing the characters. The Tetsuryo Club, comprised of the main voice actors: May Tachibana (Misaki), Mao Shōji (Kodama), Haruna Fukushima (Ushio), and Hika Tsukishiro (Usa) will perform the ending theme song "Watashi Miraisen" (My Future Line).

The anime will premiere on October 8 at 12:00 a.m. JST (effectively, October 9 at midnight) on the Tokyo MX and BS Fuji channels. HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. This year's Anime NYC event hosted the anime's world premiere on August 21.

The Tetsudō Musume characters "work" in railway companies and railway-related businesses all over Japan, wearing real uniforms and work clothes. As of May 2025, there are 114 Tetsudō Musume all over Japan. Tetsudō Musume launched in 2005, and celebrated its 20th anniversary in 2025.

title: Shogakukan Launches 'Rumiko Takahashi Fantasy Manga Awards'
content:
This year's 42nd and 43rd combined issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine announced its new " Rumiko Takahashi Fantasy Manga Awards" on Wednesday, and the organizers are currently accepting manga entries until January 11, 2027.

The contest is open to professional and amateur manga creators. Entries must be 42 pages or less and contain at least one fantasy element. Takahashi will head the panel of judges which will also include Weekly Shonen Sunday editor-in-chief Kazunori Ōshima and other Shonen Sunday editors. The organizers will announce the results in Weekly Shonen Sunday and on the awards' website on March 24.

The grand prize winner will receive 1 million yen (about US$6,000), and their manga will be published in Weekly Shonen Sunday or a spinoff publication and on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry manga website. The second prize winner will get 500,000 yen (about US$3,000), and their manga will also be published in Weekly Shonen Sunday or a spinoff publication and on Sunday Webry . The honorable mention recipient will receivie 300,000 yen (about US$2,000), and their work will appear on Sunday Webry . The effort prize recipient will receive 100,000 yen (about US$600), and the encouragement prize recipient will receive 30,000 yen (about US$200).

Takahashi debuted as a manga creator in 1978, and in her career of over three decades, Takahashi has created manga such as Urusei Yatsura , Maison Ikkoku , Mermaid Saga , Rumic Theater , Ranma 1/2 , One-Pound Gospel , and Inuyasha . Many of her works have become internationally popular and inspired anime and live-action adaptations.

The compiled volumes of all of Takahashi's manga have surpassed 230 million copies in circulation worldwide, as of August 2024.

The anime adaptation of Takahashi's MAO manga premiered on April 4, and is running for two continuous cours (quarter of a year).

The third season of the new anime based on Takahashi's Ranma 1/2 manga will debut on October 3.

A new television anime of Takahashi's Urusei Yatsura manga premiered in October 2022. The anime's first half ran for half a year, or two cours without breaks. The show's second half aired for two consecutive cours and started in January 2024. The show's fourth and final cours premiered in April that same year.

The organizers will announce the results in Weekly Shonen Sunday and on the awards' website on March 24.

The grand prize winner will receive 1 million yen (about US$6,000), and their manga will be published in Weekly Shonen Sunday or a spinoff publication and on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry manga website. The second prize winner will get 500,000 yen (about US$3,000), and their manga will also be published in Weekly Shonen Sunday or a spinoff publication and on Sunday Webry . The honorable mention recipient will receivie 300,000 yen (about US$2,000), and their work will appear on Sunday Webry . The effort prize recipient will receive 100,000 yen (about US$600), and the encouragement prize recipient will receive 30,000 yen (about US$200).

Takahashi debuted as a manga creator in 1978, and in her career of over three decades, Takahashi has created manga such as Urusei Yatsura , Maison Ikkoku , Mermaid Saga , Rumic Theater , Ranma 1/2 , One-Pound Gospel , and Inuyasha . Many of her works have become internationally popular and inspired anime and live-action adaptations.
The compiled volumes of all of Takahashi's manga have surpassed 230 million copies in circulation worldwide, as of August 2024.
The anime adaptation of Takahashi's MAO manga premiered on April 4, and is running for two continuous cours (quarter of a year).
The third season of the new anime based on Takahashi's Ranma 1/2 manga will debut on October 3.

A new television anime of Takahashi's Urusei Yatsura manga premiered in October 2022. The anime's first half ran for half a year, or two cours without breaks. The show's second half aired for two consecutive cours and started in January 2024. The show's fourth and final cours premiered in April that same year.

title: Mazenchu Food Characters Get TV Anime on October 7
content:
Graphic design company Torch announced on Wednesday that its Mazenchu character brand will receive a anime that will begin airing as the first original anime within Kansai TV 's morning news and lifestyle program Yoidon! on October 7.

Mazenchu is set in a school where all kinds of food can live out their youth and form friendships, rivalries, and bittersweet romances.

The cast includes:

• Obara Rea as Sume, a sushi rice girl

• Sakura Hayashi as Abo, an avocado girl

• Uki Nashiki as Akami, a tuna boy

• Kokoro Kikuchi as Shinko, a pickled vegetable boy

Ebi created the Mazenchu characters. Yuusuke Takase (CG on Berserk: The Golden Age Arc I - The Egg of the King , Halo Legends , Detroit Metal City ) is directing the anime at Studio Nanahoshi . The studio dugout is producing the sound, and Aiin is producing the music. Bonjin is the offline editor. Liberty Animation Studio produced the opening animation. Sayo Kawase is the executive producer, and Torch is planning and producing the project.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals 11 Character Posters Ahead of October Premiere
content:
The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has revealed a new set of 11 character posters ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere. It will lead up to the upcoming movie , which will premiere in Japan on December 11 with an original story by the author Natsu Hyuuga. The second cour of Season 3 is scheduled for April 2027.

The anime previously revealed a teaser trailer featuring the opening theme song “Kumo wo Nuke Kazashimo e Watashi Dake” by Yorushika. Studio OLM is back to handle the animation production, while TOHO animation STUDIO is notably absent from the staff credits list.

You can see the new character posters below.

ALSO READ: The Apothecary Diaries Interview: Aoi Yuki (Maomao) & Takeo Otsuka (Jinshi) Crunchyroll Reveals New York Comic Con 2026 Lineup With The Apothecary Diaries, Sentenced to Be a Hero, Black Clover and More

You can watch the trailer for the anime below.

The main staff was also previously revealed and includes:

• Director: Akinori Fudesaka

• Assistant Director: Wataru Nakagawa

• Series Composition: Norihiro Naganuma

• Scripts: Yuko Kakihara, Misuzu Chiba, Hitomi Ogawa

• Character Design: Yukiko Nakatani

• Art Director: Katsumi Takao

• Color Design: Misato Aida, Nanako Okazaki

• CGI Director: Tamotsu Nagai

• Director of Photography: Mayo Suzuki

• Editing: Daisuke Imai

• Sound Director: Shoji Hata

• Music: Satoru Kosaki, Kevin Penkin, Arisa Okehazama

• Animation Production: OLM

You can also see the key visual:

Natsu Hyuga writes the The Apothecary Diaries light novel, with illustrations by Toko Shino. The series is serialized by Shunfunotomo. The series has 2 manga adaptations, one written by Itsuki Nanao and illustrated by Nekokurage, and one written and illustrated by Minoji Kurata.

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel in English, while Squre Enix is publishing the manga. The story follows Maomao, a young apothecary who ends up getting sold to the emperor’s palace as a lowly servant. She’s not the type of character who can just stay obedient, so she ends up helping Jinshi, the handsome official at the palace.

The franchise recently also announced its first live-action series adaptation , as well as the first console game .
